summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine share buyback transactions under its existing buyback programme announced 12 March 2026. The filing details purchases of 14,288,204 ordinary shares for cancellation across multiple trading venues (London Stock Exchange, CBOE, Aquis) from 15-19 June 2026, at volume-weighted average prices between approximately 330.7p and 334.5p. The filing includes post-settlement share capital information but contains no offer, no board recommendation, no special committee, and no structural or risk-arbitrage elements. This is a standard open-market buyback disclosure; not a Capital Return special situation.
